stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Bucky and Wanda fight on Steve's side at the Leipzig airport. When Black Panther is about to cut Bucky's throat, Wanda stops his hand with her powers.
stages.whoA: A teammate on Steve's side, who stops Black Panther's claws at his throat.
stages.whoB: Steve's friend. She stops Black Panther from cutting his throat at the airport.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky and Peggy fight HYDRA on the same side of Steve's war. At the London pub, Bucky asks her to dance, but she has eyes only for Steve.
stages.whoA: Agent Carter. He asks her to dance, but she only has eyes for Steve.
stages.whoB: Steve's best friend, who asks her to dance at the London pub.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Bruce and Clint are recruited to the Avengers when Loki attacks. Once Clint is freed from Loki's control, they fight side by side in the Battle of New York.
stages.whoA: Hawkeye, a fellow Avenger he fights beside in New York.
stages.whoB: The Hulk, a fellow Avenger he fights beside in New York.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Bruce runs the time machine that sends Clint into the past. When Clint comes back from Vormir alone, Bruce is the first to ask about Natasha, and later Bruce's snap brings Clint's family back.
stages.whoA: Time Heist teammate. They grieve Natasha, and Bruce's snap brings back Clint's family.
stages.whoB: Time Heist teammate, whose snap brings back his family. They grieve Natasha together.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bucky and Rocket fight Thanos's army side by side in Wakanda, with Bucky spinning Rocket around as they both fire. Afterward Rocket asks to buy Bucky's gun, then his arm.
stages.whoA: A Guardian who fights beside him in Wakanda and tries to buy his arm.
stages.whoB: A soldier he fights beside in Wakanda, whose gun and arm he wants.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bruce crashes through the roof of Strange's Sanctum to warn him that Thanos is coming. Strange takes him to find Tony, and they face Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian in New York together.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer whose Sanctum he crashes into to warn of Thanos.
stages.whoB: The Hulk, who crashes into his Sanctum to warn him of Thanos.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Challa joins Tony's side at the Leipzig airport, set on catching Bucky, whom he blames for his father's death. They fight Steve's team together.
stages.whoA: Black Panther, who fights on his side at the Leipzig airport.
stages.whoB: Iron Man, whose side he joins at the airport to catch Bucky.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bruce meets T'Challa when the Avengers bring Vision to Wakanda, and Rhodes tricks him into bowing to the king. He then fights in the Hulkbuster armor alongside T'Challa against Thanos's army.
stages.whoA: The king of Wakanda. Rhodes tricks him into bowing, then they fight Thanos's army.
stages.whoB: An Avenger who bows to him as a joke, then fights for Wakanda.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Yo-Yo and Daniel Sousa become teammates after S.H.I.E.L.D. saves him from his death in 1955. They fight together to retake the Lighthouse, teasing each other about worrying over Mack and Daisy.
stages.whoA: An SSR agent saved from 1955, now her teammate on the Zephyr.
stages.whoB: A teammate on the Zephyr who fights beside him to retake the Lighthouse.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: On Titan, Tony and Drax first clash, each side believing the other works for Thanos. They then team up to ambush Thanos, though Drax yawns through Tony's plan.
stages.whoA: A Guardian he first fights on Titan, then teams up with against Thanos.
stages.whoB: Iron Man. They clash on Titan, then team up to ambush Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Maria Hill works with the Avengers out of their tower. At Tony's party she teases Thor and Tony as they argue over whose girlfriend is more impressive, then fights Ultron's robots beside them.
stages.whoA: Fury's old deputy, now working with the Avengers. She teases him about Jane.
stages.whoB: An Avenger she works with, and teases at Tony's party about Jane.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Disguised as a HYDRA guard, Maria Hill frees Sam, Steve and Natasha from a prison transport. She then helps them break into the Triskelion and runs the control room while Sam and Steve take down the helicarriers.
stages.whoA: The Falcon, whom she frees from HYDRA and helps take down the helicarriers.
stages.whoB: Fury's deputy, who frees him from HYDRA and helps stop Project Insight.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: When the FBI tries to take Karen from the church, Mahoney stands up to Agent Poindexter and insists the police have custody. Poindexter, who means to kill her, blames Mahoney for losing his chance.
stages.whoA: A crooked FBI agent he stops from taking Karen into custody.
stages.whoB: The NYPD sergeant who keeps Karen out of his hands.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: When the Hand comes after Trish, Matt follows Jessica to Trish's studio and helps get her to safety.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, whom he helps get away from the Hand.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who helps Jessica save her from the Hand.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Tony and Mantis meet on Titan and team up against Thanos. Mantis holds Thanos still with her powers while Tony and Peter Parker try to pull off his gauntlet.
stages.whoA: A Guardian who holds Thanos still while he tries to take the gauntlet.
stages.whoB: Iron Man, who tries to pull off the gauntlet while she holds Thanos.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Maria Hill works with Talos to track Gravik's Skrull rebels. Together they bring Nick Fury back to Earth to stop the invasion.
stages.whoA: A Skrull ally. Together they call Fury home to stop Gravik.
stages.whoB: Fury's old friend, who works with him against Gravik's rebels.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Groot arrives in Wakanda with Thor and Rocket and fights beside Steve against Thanos's army. When Groot introduces himself, Steve answers, "I am Steve Rogers."
stages.whoA: A Guardian who fights beside him in Wakanda. Steve introduces himself back.
stages.whoB: Captain America, who answers his greeting with "I am Steve Rogers."

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis turns on Ego and stays with the Guardians, becoming part of the team that is raising Baby Groot.
stages.whoA: A new Guardian who joins the team after Ego.
stages.whoB: Baby Groot, part of the team she joins after Ego.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Groot and Mantis fight side by side to save Rocket from the High Evolutionary. Afterward Mantis leaves the team to find her own path, while Groot stays.
stages.whoA: A teammate who fights beside him to save Rocket, then leaves the team.
stages.whoB: A teammate she fights beside to save Rocket before she leaves.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wesley walks into Nelson and Murdock's new office, refuses to give his name, and hires them with a check on behalf of an unnamed employer. He is Fisk's right hand, and he keeps a file on Foggy and Matt for Fisk.
stages.whoA: Fisk's right hand, who hires the firm without giving his name.
stages.whoB: Matt's law partner, whom he hires and keeps a file on for Fisk.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire Temple brings Jeri to Danny and Colleen while they hide. Jeri lays out the DEA's drug case against them both, and Danny sees the evidence has been doctored.
stages.whoA: Danny's partner, whose DEA case she lays out for them.
stages.whoB: Danny's lawyer, who lays out the DEA case against her.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Rumlow and Sitwell are both HYDRA agents hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D. When Steve is branded a fugitive, Sitwell runs the operation and sends Rumlow's STRIKE team to capture him.
stages.whoA: A fellow HYDRA mole, who sends his team after Steve.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA STRIKE leader he sends to capture Steve.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: During Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin catches Baby Groot searching for Yondu's fin. Regretting the mutiny, he brings it himself so Groot, Rocket and Yondu can break free.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who brings Yondu's fin so they can break free.
stages.whoB: Baby Groot, whom he helps break free by bringing Yondu's fin.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Years later, Groot and Kraglin are both Guardians living on Knowhere, and both join the fight against the High Evolutionary.
stages.whoA: A fellow Guardian on Knowhere.
stages.whoB: A fellow Guardian on Knowhere.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: At Thor's request, Heimdall keeps watch over Jane on Earth and is shaken when she vanishes from his sight. When Thor smuggles her out of Asgard, Heimdall distracts Odin by confessing to treason.
stages.whoA: Asgard's watchman, who helps Thor smuggle her out of Asgard.
stages.whoB: Thor's love, whom he watches over and helps smuggle out of Asgard.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Luis is Scott's best friend and business partner, and he often comes by to play with Cassie while Scott is under house arrest.
stages.whoA: Her dad's best friend, who comes by to play with them.
stages.whoB: Scott's daughter, whom he plays with during Scott's house arrest.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: At the Damage Control office, Sadie Deever shows Cleary a video of the enhanced girl from AvengerCon. He orders her to bring the girl in.
stages.whoA: A Damage Control agent he sends to bring in Ms. Marvel.
stages.whoB: Her Damage Control superior, who orders her to bring in Ms. Marvel.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Odin is the king the Warriors Three serve. He rescues them and Thor from the Frost Giants on Jotunheim, then has the wounded Fandral taken to be healed.
stages.whoA: His warriors, whom he rescues from the Frost Giants on Jotunheim.
stages.whoB: Their king, who rescues them from the Frost Giants on Jotunheim.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Colonel Ramon of the Colombian police asks S.H.I.E.L.D. for help with an Inhuman stealing his guns, and Daisy comes to meet him. He turns out to be corrupt and holds Bobbi and Hunter, until Daisy and the team storm his station.
stages.whoA: A corrupt Colombian colonel who holds her friends until she storms in.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who storms his station to free her team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Out of prison, Ramon tries to sell a stolen 0-8-4 to the Watchdogs. Daisy, now the vigilante Quake, tracks the deal and knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The corrupt colonel she knocks out at his Watchdogs deal.
stages.whoB: Quake, who breaks up his deal with the Watchdogs.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Ramon is the corrupt Colombian colonel holding Bobbi and Hunter. When the team storms his station, he tries to slip away, and Mack knocks him out at the door.
stages.whoA: A corrupt colonel he knocks out as he tries to escape.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who knocks him out at the door.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Bruce and Tony turn the Scepter's code into the Ultron Program. Ultron wakes while they are at the party and tears J.A.R.V.I.S. apart. Bruce then helps Tony upload what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into the body that becomes Vision.
stages.whoA: Tony's partner on Ultron, who helps upload him into Vision's body.
stages.whoB: Tony's A.I. He helps build Ultron, then becomes part of Vision.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ellison backs Karen in trying to keep Fisk in prison for Ben Urich's murder. Fisk strikes back by sending Poindexter, dressed as Daredevil, to attack the Bulletin and kill their witness.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who has his newsroom attacked to kill their witness.
stages.whoB: The Bulletin editor fighting to keep him in prison.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dugan and Morita are prisoners Steve frees from HYDRA, and both join his Howling Commandos. Morita sets Dugan straight when Dugan takes him for the enemy, and they fight HYDRA side by side.
stages.whoA: A fellow Howling Commando, freed from HYDRA with him.
stages.whoB: A fellow Howling Commando, freed from HYDRA with him.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Young Monica meets Goose when Carol and Fury visit her mother's house. Monica pets the Flerken, and Goose purrs and makes friends with her.
stages.whoA: Carol's Flerken, who makes friends with her as a girl.
stages.whoB: Maria's young daughter, who pets her and befriends her.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Poindexter opens fire on Josie's bar, shooting Foggy and killing others before Daredevil stops him. Josie flees as the two fight.
stages.whoA: Bullseye, the killer who shoots up her bar and kills Foggy.
stages.whoB: The owner of the bar he attacks to kill Foggy.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: On Sakaar, Valkyrie breaks into the prisons, frees Miek, Korg and the other gladiators, and disables their obedience disks. Miek joins the revolt that follows.
stages.whoA: A Sakaar gladiator she frees, who joins the revolt.
stages.whoB: The warrior who frees her from the Sakaar prisons.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Vision is born in the fight against Ultron and fights beside Steve's Avengers in Sokovia. Afterward he joins the new Avengers team that Steve trains.
stages.whoA: A new Avenger, born to fight Ultron, whom he leads and trains.
stages.whoB: The captain who leads him against Ultron and trains the new Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision backs the Sokovia Accords and stands with Tony, while Steve refuses to sign. At the Leipzig airport, Vision blocks Steve's team from escaping.
stages.whoA: A rival on Tony's side, who blocks his escape at the airport.
stages.whoB: The captain who refuses the Accords and fights Tony's side.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Steve, Natasha and Sam save Vision and Wanda from Thanos's children in Edinburgh. Steve refuses to sacrifice Vision for the Mind Stone and brings him to Wakanda to protect him.
stages.whoA: A friend he rescues in Edinburgh and refuses to sacrifice for the Stone.
stages.whoB: The captain who rescues him and refuses to trade his life.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Clint comes to the Avengers compound to free Wanda, whom Vision is keeping inside. Vision overpowers him, until Wanda turns her powers on Vision and drives him into the ground.
stages.whoA: An old teammate who keeps Wanda in, until she drives him into the ground.
stages.whoB: A former Avenger who breaks Wanda out of the compound past him.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision sides with Tony and the Accords, and Sam with Steve. At the Leipzig airport, Vision fires at Sam, but the blast strikes Rhodes instead.
stages.whoA: A rival on Steve's side. His shot at Sam misses and hits Rhodes.
stages.whoB: A rival on Tony's side, whose shot at him hits Rhodes instead.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Sam flies in with Steve and Natasha to save Vision and Wanda in Edinburgh, then helps defend Vision in Wakanda.
stages.whoA: An ally who rescues him in Edinburgh and defends him in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: The Avenger he rescues in Edinburgh and defends in Wakanda.
